body.statement: Along the retained even tail \(n\ge N_0\), the maximum in \(q_{*,\alpha}(u,B_0)\) exists, its defining integral is computable, and the interval \(I_n\) obeys the sequencewise design-based guarantee \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}\Pr(\tau_n\in I_n)\ge1-\alpha\) for every sequence in \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PSRR}}\).
body.justification: Heterogeneous effects leave the cross-potential-outcome residual covariance unidentified, and the envelope converts that obstacle into an observable conservative reference law.
body.gap: Fiksel's covariate-adjusted interval is a Fisher-exact randomization-test inversion under an observed-data sufficient condition, while Li and Ding's conservative law and Cohen and Fogarty's Gaussian push-forward concern uniform constrained designs; none supplies the clipped first-entry PSRR weak-null envelope.
body.consumer: Investigators using the original PSRR workflow obtain a single-run, observed-moment ATE confidence interval under heterogeneous effects without Fisher sharp-null inversion or regenerating assignments over hypothesized effects.
